note: Set A covers the Module B (C1) member systematically — total length 10'-3 3/4", the three horizontal segments (3'-8 3/8", 3'-6", 3'-1 5/16", which sum to the total) and the 3/8" THROUGH BOLT — plus the Module A right segment, all supported by the text layer. Set B instead adds the Module A total length 12'-3 3/4", the L3X3X1/4 angle profile and the Module A left segment (2'-3 7/8" + 7'-0" + 2'-11 7/8" = 12'-3 3/4"), but drops the entire Module B dimension set and the fastener, so it omits more important facts. Both sets repeat facts under two names (A: 2'-5 5/16" and 3"; B: 4" and 1'-11 1/8") and both attach unverifiable witness-line conditions to the base-plate dimensions, where A's "hole center height 2\" from bottom" and B's "width 4 3/4\" from edge of post to edge of plate" (self-contradictory) are the weakest readings. On balance A is the more complete and more faithful set.
remarks: The base-plate/base-block dimension strings (3", 4 3/4" / 4 13/16", 2", 4") are too small in the image to confirm which witness lines they span, so both sets' conditions on these values are guesses; A calls the same object 'base block' and B 'base plate'/'base block' inconsistently. Both sets also carry 'component B | width | 6 3/16"' although 6 3/16" is one of the vertical segment dimensions (1'-11 1/8" + 6 3/16" = 2'-5 5/16"), i.e. likely misbound in both. Set B's support-post claim has a malformed value string (stray trailing quote). Shared vague entities ('component', 'PV detail', 'beam') appear in both and were not penalized asymmetrically.
